name: Jen Jefferies
quote: If I could give Rob 50 stars I would. My yard was overgrown and I was feeling defeated and overwhelmed with the budget I had to work with. Rob was responsive, kind, timely, budget conscious, and the quality of his work is 11/10. The difference in my yard and the way I feel about my property is astounding!

name: Terry Jefferies
quote: Hands down the best property maintenance in Kelowna! Having been burned by other services in the past, we were skeptical — but Rob blew all our expectations out of the water. He showed up exactly when he said he would, and the progress he made in one afternoon was astounding. He wouldn't even accept payment until every last bit of debris was hauled away and the job was 100% complete.

name: Karen Wyonzek
quote: Professional, hardworking, and paid attention to every detail from start to finish. They showed up on time, communicated clearly, and the quality exceeded my expectations.
